needs_review.issue: SCREENING EXCLUSION - explicit volunteers, deliberately not emitted
needs_review.finding: Ratio Christi's giving site uses a SECOND path, give.ratiochristi.org/volunteer/<first>-<last>, parallel to /missionary/<first>-<last>. People on the /volunteer/ path are the tent-maker volunteers the brief warned about. Excluded: Josh Runyan, Eric Chabot, Reitze Rodseth, Christian Castro, Mark Tabladillo.
needs_review.recommendation: Treat the /volunteer/ path as a hard reject list for Ratio Christi and add it to the org's hunt_negatives notes. Eric Chabot is the load-bearing case: he is the named Ohio State chapter director on chapters.ratiochristi.org and would have been emitted Tier A by any agent grading chapter directors by role. Also add these five surnames to any future exclusion sweep.

needs_review.issue: SCREENING EXCLUSION - explicitly volunteer national leadership
needs_review.finding: Eric Scott serves as a VOLUNTEER on Ratio Christi's national leadership team. He nonetheless has a page at give.ratiochristi.org/missionary/eric-scott/.
needs_review.evidence: https://give.ratiochristi.org/missionary/eric-scott/ - page copy states he serves as a volunteer on the national leadership team
needs_review.recommendation: Do not emit. Important caveat for the ingest rule: a /missionary/ path page is NOT by itself sufficient proof of personal support - this one page contradicts the path. The page copy must be read. Since fetching was blocked, other /missionary/ pages emitted here as Tier A carry a small residual risk of the same contradiction; a single fetch pass over the emitted URLs looking for the word 'volunteer' would retire it cheaply.

needs_review.issue: Named chapter directors with no giving page - volunteer or supported unknown
needs_review.finding: North Carolina State University lists three Assistant Chapter Directors: Forrest DeVita, Benji Smith and David Gustafson. No give.ratiochristi.org page surfaced for any of them on either the /missionary/ or /volunteer/ path.
needs_review.recommendation: Hold. 'Assistant Chapter Director' is described by Ratio Christi as a role for people 'exploring the call to ministry', which is exactly the profile most likely to be unpaid. Resolve by checking each name against both give.ratiochristi.org paths before any outreach.

needs_review.issue: Named chapter director with no giving page - volunteer or supported unknown
needs_review.finding: Robert Johnson is named as chapter director for Penn State Altoona on the chapters index. No giving page found on either path.
needs_review.recommendation: Hold pending a /missionary/ vs /volunteer/ path check. 'Robert Johnson' is also a high-collision name, so confirm identity before matching.

needs_review.issue: International staff outside the US giving platform
needs_review.finding: Simon Brace is Regional Director of Ratio Christi in South Africa and Chapter Director at North West University. He has a bio at ratiochristi.org/people/simon-brace/ but no page on give.ratiochristi.org under either path.
needs_review.recommendation: Likely a real supported staffer funded through the separate South African entity (ratiochristi.co.za) rather than the US platform, so the absence of a US giving page is not evidence of volunteer status. Resolve against ratiochristi.co.za/about/our-team-new/. Same caution applies to the whole South African and Canadian rosters.

needs_review.issue: Spouse named as staff but not on the title or slug
needs_review.finding: Danny Loe's giving page states 'His wife, Rebekah, is also on staff with Ratio Christi.' The page title is 'Danny Loe' alone and the slug is danny-loe.
needs_review.recommendation: Not emitted. The standing rule permits a spouse only when the TITLE names them on a shared family page; here she is named in body copy only. She is explicitly described as staff, so she probably has her own page - search give.ratiochristi.org for 'Rebekah Loe' to confirm and emit separately.

needs_review.issue: The ratiochristi.org/people/ bio directory mixes employed staff with academic advisory board
needs_review.finding: The /people/<first>-<last>/ directory returns operational staff (Larry Baxter COO, Bob Clapper, Tony Feiger, Chris Laurent) alongside names that read as academic advisory board or speakers bureau rather than staff: Jeremy Tedesco, Leo Percer, W. Craig Fowler, Paul Tseng.
needs_review.recommendation: Do NOT enumerate /people/ as a staff roster. The reliable test used in this slice was to cross-check each /people/ name against give.ratiochristi.org: a /missionary/ hit upgrades to Tier A, a /volunteer/ hit is a reject, and no hit means hold. Note Rick James appears in /people/ AND has a giving page, so he is staff, not board - the directory gives no way to tell these apart on its own.

needs_review.issue: Roster not exhausted - budget ran out mid-yield
needs_review.finding: The final search of the budget returned eight new people out of ten results. The /missionary/ path was still producing at full rate when the budget ended, and three couple pages with surname-only slugs (james, stewart, pankratz) appeared only in that last query, implying more surname-only slugs remain unseen.
needs_review.recommendation: This target deserves one more pass, and it should be a FETCHING pass rather than a search pass: give.ratiochristi.org/missionaries and give.ratiochristi.org/volunteer would together resolve the whole supported-vs-volunteer split in two requests, which eighteen searches could not. Surname-only slugs are the enumeration trap here - a slug like /missionary/stewart is invisible to any first-name-based query.
